title: PoliticalMayhemActionPlan
description: Structured action proposal emitted by the AI Strategic Commander. Every action requires explicit human approval and deterministic GameActionValidator verification before Photon Host execution.

summary.description: Concise human-readable tactical recommendation grounded in MCP state and RAG rules.

confidence.description: Normalized confidence in [0, 1]. Must be lowered if tool data is incomplete or stale.

actions.description: Zero or more proposed gameplay actions. Empty array is valid for read-only advice or blocked requests.

unit_type.description: Canonical unit identifier (e.g., campaign_volunteer, propagandist, bodyguard, rally_convoy).

city_name.description: Canonical city identifier (Baskent, Limankent, Demirkent, Yesilova, Universitekent, Dagsehir).

target_zone.description: Target tactical sub-zone within or around a city (e.g., RallySquare, HarborGate, IndustrialDistrict).

count.description: Integer unit count for deployment or movement orders.

bribe_amount.description: Party budget allocation for Election Night Phase 2 bribery only (capped by player budget).

ideology_focus.description: Canonical ideology target (nationalist, liberal, democrat, communist, imperialist).

reason.description: Short rationale citing observed game state or RAG rule.
